newsitem.title: USA: Computer Data Systems unit gets contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Data Systems unit gets contract.

text.p: Computer Data Systems Inc said Wednesday that a division has won a government contract with a potential value of $310 million.

The division, CDSI Information Technology Solutions Co, was awarded a contract by the General Services Administration in Fort Worth, Texas, to provide business, scientific, risk analysis and security-related information system services.

CDSI has been performing the work for the past 4-1/2 years. If all options with this latest contract are exercised, it would run through May 2002. It has a potential contract value of $310 million, it said.
